options.content:
GPU readiness checks — throttle state, HBM and violation counters
There is no dcgmi diag exporter in this deployment, so no r1–r4 pass/fail record exists to display. This board runs the equivalent gates continuously against the DCGM fields that are collected from every tray reporting DCGM: clock-throttle reason, HBM capacity and occupancy, and the cumulative power / reliability / low-utilisation violation counters. Every tile below is a gate; each one is backed by a table naming the exact GPUs.
GPU area › Area home  ·  Coverage · thermal · power · clocks  ·  Error surface — ECC · XID · violations  ·  NVLink & bandwidth  ·  Readiness checks

panels.title: Readiness gates — every GPU in scope, checked against the live DCGM fields

panels.description: Distinct GPUs tripping at least one of the five gates to the right. The table below is built from the identical expression — its row count equals this number. Note that one of the five gates, 'Holding more than 1 GiB of HBM', is tripped by any GPU running a job, so a non-zero value here is not by itself a fault: read the 'Gates failed' and 'Throttle reason' columns below to see which gate fired.

targets.expr: count(count by(node, rack, su, gpu) ((label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1, "gate", "throttle_not_idle", "", "") or label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1024, "gate", "hbm_allocated", "", "") or label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000, "gate", "hbm_reduced", "", "") or label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0, "gate", "power_violation", "", "") or label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0, "gate", "reliability_violation", "", "")))) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs tripping a readiness gate

panels.description: DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS is a bitmask; bit 0 (value 1) is 'GPU idle' and every GPU on this fleet currently reports exactly that. This gate counts anything above idle — software or hardware power cap, thermal slowdown, sync boost. Named in the 'Throttle reason' column of the table below.

targets.expr: count(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: Throttled — not idle

panels.description: GPUs with more than 1 GiB of resident framebuffer. Read it against what the estate is doing: before a run this is a leaked context and should be cleared; during a run it simply means the GPU is in use and is expected. It is amber, not red, for that reason. The 'HBM in use' column of the table below names the exact GPUs, and 'HBM in use by SU' shows whether the allocation tracks a live job.

targets.expr: count(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 1024) or vector(0)

panels.title: Holding more than 1 GiB of HBM

panels.description: GPUs whose total framebuffer (free + used) is under 282,000 MiB. A healthy GB300 presents 283,136 MiB; a lower figure means HBM has been retired. Named in the 'HBM presented' column below.

targets.expr: count((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000) or vector(0)

panels.title: Presenting reduced HBM

panels.description: GPUs whose DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION counter is still increasing over the last 15 minutes, i.e. they are being held back by the enforced power cap right now. The lifetime total is large on most GPUs; only the derivative tells you it is happening now.

targets.expr: count(rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Power-cap viol. accruing

panels.description: GPUs whose DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION counter is still increasing over the last 15 minutes.

targets.expr: count(rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: Reliability viol. accruing

panels.description: Worklist for the six tiles above, built from the identical selector, filter and variables. The row count equals 'GPUs failing a readiness gate'; each of the other five tiles equals the number of rows breaching that column.

defaults.noValue: Every GPU in scope passes all five readiness gates.

targets.expr: count by(node, rack, su, gpu) ((label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1, "gate", "throttle_not_idle", "", "") or label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1024, "gate", "hbm_allocated", "", "") or label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000, "gate", "hbm_reduced", "", "") or label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0, "gate", "power_violation", "", "") or label_replace(max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0, "gate", "reliability_violation", "", "")))

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) and on(node, gpu) ((max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1024) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0))

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} * 1048576) and on(node, gpu) ((max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1024) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0))

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) * 1048576) and on(node, gpu) ((max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1024) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0))

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) and on(node, gpu) ((max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1024) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0))

max by(node, rack, su, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) and on(node, gpu) ((max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) > 1024) or (max by(node, gpu) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0) or (max by(node, gpu) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m])) > 0))

panels.title: GPUs tripping a readiness gate — the exact GPUs

panels.description: L2 for the stat 'Throttled — not idle'. Row count equals count(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS > 1) under the same $cluster/$datahall/$su/$rack/$node/$gpu variables. Value is the DCGM throttle-reason bitmask.

defaults.noValue: None in scope — nothing matches this gate right now.

targets.expr: DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 1

panels.title: Throttled GPUs — the exact GPUs

panels.description: L2 for the stat 'Holding more than 1 GiB of HBM'. Row count equals count(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED > 1024) under the same variables.

defaults.noValue: None in scope — nothing matches this gate right now.

targets.expr: DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 1024

panels.title: GPUs holding more than 1 GiB of HBM — the exact GPUs

panels.description: L2 for the stat 'Presenting reduced HBM'. Row count equals count((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED) < 282000) under the same variables — the same 282000 MiB threshold the stat uses.

defaults.noValue: None in scope — nothing matches this gate right now.

targets.expr: (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) < 282000

panels.title: GPUs presenting reduced HBM — the exact GPUs

panels.description: L2 for the stat 'Power-cap viol. accruing'. Row count equals count(rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION[15m]) > 0) under the same variables.

defaults.noValue: None in scope — nothing matches this gate right now.

targets.expr: rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0

panels.title: GPUs accruing power-cap violations — the exact GPUs

panels.description: L2 for the stat 'Reliability viol. accruing'. Row count equals count(rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION[15m]) > 0) under the same variables.

defaults.noValue: None in scope — nothing matches this gate right now.

targets.expr: rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0

panels.title: GPUs accruing reliability violations — the exact GPUs
HBM capacity and occupancy

panels.description: Sum of free + used framebuffer over every GPU reporting DCGM in scope. Decomposed per rack in the table below — the 'HBM presented' column sums to this number.

targets.expr: sum((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) * 1048576)

panels.title: HBM presented by the fleet

panels.description: Sum of used framebuffer over the same GPUs. Decomposed per rack in the table below — the 'HBM in use' column sums to this number.

targets.expr: sum(DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} * 1048576)

panels.title: HBM currently in use

panels.description: Decomposition of the two tiles above, same selector and same variables. Every column is additive and the footer prints the totals: HBM presented sums to "HBM presented by the fleet", HBM in use sums to "HBM currently in use".

targets.expr: sum by(rack, su) ((DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_FREE{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} + DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}) * 1048576)
sum by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} * 1048576)
count by(rack, su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"})

panels.title: HBM by rack — the exact racks in scope

panels.description: Per-SU decomposition of the 'HBM currently in use' tile; the series sum to it.

targets.expr: sum by(su) (DCGM_FI_DEV_FB_USED{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} * 1048576)

panels.title: HBM in use by SU
Violation counters — what the GPUs are still accruing

panels.description: GPUs whose DCGM_FI_DEV_LOW_UTIL_VIOLATION counter is still increasing over the last 15 minutes. On an idle estate this is expected to be nearly every GPU; it is the control that proves the violation counters are live, which is what makes the two zero-valued gates above meaningful. Decomposed per rack directly below — the GPUs column sums to this number.

targets.expr: count(rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_LOW_UTIL_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs accruing idle-throttle time

panels.description: Fleet counts over time for the four gates that are derived from counters: power-cap, reliability and low-utilisation accrual, plus the non-idle throttle gate. Each series is the same expression as the matching tile above, so a step here is the tile changing. The counters' unit is left unconverted: DCGM documents these fields as microseconds but this fleet accrues them at roughly 1e9 per second, so only the direction (accruing / not accruing) is stated as fact.

targets.expr: count(rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_POWER_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0) or vector(0)
count(rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_RELIABILITY_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0) or vector(0)
count(rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_LOW_UTIL_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0) or vector(0)
count(DCGM_FI_DEV_CLOCK_THROTTLE_REASONS{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"} > 1) or vector(0)

panels.title: GPUs accruing each violation, and GPUs throttled for a non-idle reason

panels.description: Decomposition of the tile above, same selector and same variables: the GPUs column sums to it exactly.

defaults.noValue: No GPU in scope is accruing idle-throttle time.

targets.expr: count by(rack, su) (rate(DCGM_FI_DEV_LOW_UTIL_VIOLATION{cluster=~"$cluster", datahall=~"$datahall", su=~"$su", rack=~"$rack", node=~"$node", gpu=~"$gpu"}[15m]) > 0)

panels.title: Idle-throttle accrual by rack — the exact racks

title: GPU Readiness Checks — Throttle · HBM · Violation Counters
